+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""W17 Coder-4: androguard-decompile the CB missing-args chain to find where
+'hostId' loses its 'h' (becomes 'ostId')."""
+import sys, zipfile
+from loguru import logger
+logger.remove()
+from androguard.misc import AnalyzeDex
+
+APK = '/home/z/my-project/upload/org.connectbot_11101000.apk'
+zf = zipfile.ZipFile(APK)
+dexdata = None
+for n in sorted(zf.namelist()):
+    if not n.endswith('.dex'): continue
+    data = zf.read(n)
+    # quick containment check
+    if b'NavDestinationBuilder' in data:
+        print('NavDestinationBuilder in', n)
+        if dexdata is None: dexdata = (n, data)
+
+open('/tmp/cb_nav.dex','wb').write(dexdata[1])
+res = AnalyzeDex('/tmp/cb_nav.dex')
+dx = res[-1]
+
+def disasm(class_sub, method_sub, max_ins=80):
+    found = False
+    for c in dx.get_classes():
+        if class_sub in c.name:
+            for m in c.get_methods():
+                if method_sub in (m.name or ''):
+                    print(f'\n===== {c.name} -> {m.name} {m.descriptor} =====')
+                    mm = m.get_method()
+                    if not mm.get_code():
+                        print('  (no code)'); continue
+                    n = 0
+                    for ins in mm.get_instructions():
+                        print('  ', ins.get_name(), ins.get_output()[:120])
+                        n += 1
+                        if n >= max_ins:
+                            print('   ...'); break
+                    found = True
+    if not found:
+        print(f'!! no method {class_sub}#{method_sub}')
+
+# 1. the builder that throws
+disasm('NavDestinationBuilder', 'build', 120)
+# 2. the missing-args name parser (androidx navigation internals)
+for sub in ['NavDestinationKt', 'NavRoute', 'RouteBuilderKt', 'nav/NavDestination;']:
+    disasm(sub, 'missing', 60)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""W17 Coder-4: decompile NC's Conscrypt.getVersion + Version.major chain."""
+import sys, zipfile
+from loguru import logger
+logger.remove()
+from androguard.misc import AnalyzeDex
+
+APK = '/home/z/my-project/upload/com.nextcloud.client_350000290.apk'
+zf = zipfile.ZipFile(APK)
+for n in sorted(zf.namelist()):
+    if n.endswith('.dex') and b'org/conscrypt/Conscrypt;' in zf.read(n)[:50_000_000]:
+        pass
+# find which dex has the Conscrypt class
+target = None
+for n in sorted(zf.namelist()):
+    if not n.endswith('.dex'): continue
+    data = zf.read(n)
+    if b'Lorg/conscrypt/Conscrypt;' in data:
+        print('Conscrypt in', n)
+        target = data
+        break
+open('/tmp/nc_cons.dex','wb').write(target)
+res = AnalyzeDex('/tmp/nc_cons.dex')
+dx = res[-1]
+
+def disasm(cls, meth, max_ins=45):
+    for c in dx.get_classes():
+        if c.name == cls:
+            for m in c.get_methods():
+                if m.name == meth:
+                    print(f'\n===== {c.name} -> {m.name} {m.descriptor} =====')
+                    mm = m.get_method()
+                    if not mm.get_code():
+                        print('  (no code — abstract/native)'); continue
+                    i = 0
+                    for ins in mm.get_instructions():
+                        print('  ', ins.get_name(), ins.get_output()[:120])
+                        i += 1
+                        if i >= max_ins: break
+                    return
+
+disasm('Lorg/conscrypt/Conscrypt;', 'getVersion', 40)
+disasm('Lorg/conscrypt/Conscrypt$Version;', 'major', 25)
+# also the Version constructor / holder
+for c in dx.get_classes():
+    if 'Conscrypt$Version' in c.name and c.name != 'Lorg/conscrypt/Conscrypt$Version;':
+        print('\nclass found:', c.name)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""W17 Coder-4: R8-proof string probe — find WHICH DEX + which class holds the
+exact IAE/NPE message strings, then locate the referencing methods.
+
+Tusky: "The view is not a child of CoordinatorLayout"
+NC:    WorkContinuationImpl / EnqueueUtils faces
+"""
+import sys, json, zipfile
+from loguru import logger
+logger.remove()
+from androguard.core.dex import DEX
+
+def scan(path, needles):
+    zf = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
+    dexes = sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith('.dex'))
+    hits = []
+    for n in dexes:
+        try:
+            d = DEX(zf.read(n))
+        except Exception as e:
+            print(f'! {n}: {e}', file=sys.stderr); continue
+        smap = {}
+        for s in d.get_strings():
+            for needle in needles:
+                if needle in s:
+                    smap.setdefault(needle, []).append(s)
+        if smap:
+            print(f'  {n}:')
+            for needle, strs in smap.items():
+                print(f'    [{needle[:40]}] {len(strs)} strings')
+                for s in strs[:4]:
+                    print(f'        "{s[:110]}"')
+            hits.append((n, smap))
+    return hits
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    which = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'TSK'
+    if which == 'TSK':
+        scan('/home/z/my-project/upload/com.keylesspalace.tusky_145.apk',
+             ['not a child of CoordinatorLayout', 'BottomSheetBehavior',
+              'app:layout_behavior', 'behavior_peekHeight'])
+    elif which == 'NC':
+        scan('/home/z/my-project/upload/com.nextcloud.client_350000290.apk',
+             ['must not be null', 'checkContentUri', 'WorkContinuationImpl'])
+    elif which == 'TB':
+        scan('/home/z/my-project/upload/net.thunderbird.android_33.apk',
+             ['NoDefinitionFoundException', 'org.koin', 'Definition not found'])

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""W17 Coder-4: locate the exact throwing method for an IAE message string
+and disassemble it (Tusky BottomSheet wall)."""
+import sys, zipfile
+from loguru import logger
+logger.remove()
+from androguard.misc import AnalyzeDex
+
+TARGET = 'The view is not a child of CoordinatorLayout'
+APK = '/home/z/my-project/upload/com.keylesspalace.tusky_145.apk'
+
+zf = zipfile.ZipFile(APK)
+data = zf.read('classes.dex')
+open('/tmp/tusky_classes.dex', 'wb').write(data)
+print('dex bytes:', len(data))
+
+res = AnalyzeDex('/tmp/tusky_classes.dex')
+d, dx = res[0], res[-1]  # androguard 4.x returns (dvm, dx) or (dvm, d, dx)
+print('analysis done', flush=True)
+
+for sa in dx.find_strings(TARGET):
+    print('STRING:', sa.get_value())
+    for _, meth in sa.get_xref_from():
+        print(' referenced by:', meth.class_name, '->', meth.name, meth.descriptor)
+        # disassemble the referencing method
+        try:
+            code = meth.get_method().get_code()
+            if code:
+                print('   --- bytecode head ---')
+                n = 0
+                for ins in meth.get_method().get_instructions():
+                    print('   ', ins.get_name(), ins.get_output()[:110])
+                    n += 1
+                    if n > 45: break
+        except Exception as e:
+            print('   (disasm err)', e)
